description:
lets you chart a path between signs. You need to create a path between two signs to create a chartable path. The Plows from Astikor Carts can be used to make these paths, instead of manually tilling the ground, but you can also use other blocks.

This is a good way of creating waypoints between bases/setups as Waystones are unobtainable and cost XP to use.
display.title: Charting our roads
